nodes.name: canonical.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the canonical domain record types (sessions, activity, file changes, edit artifacts, diff chunks, checkpoints) that form the shared data model persisted and consumed across the orgtrack-core crate.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust structs/enums annotated with serde for JSON/SQLite (de)serialization; imports the privacy module for redaction-aware fields.

nodes.name: development_artifact.rs
nodes.summary: Parses git-related development artifacts (PR links, commit URLs, push/commit tool output) out of agent tool-call payloads to attach provenance metadata to sessions.

nodes.name: edit_extraction.rs
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw edit-tool events into unified diff artifacts, merging overlapping hunks and computing final net diffs/numstat for a session's file edits.

nodes.name: edit_extraction_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for edit_extraction.rs covering hunk merging, net-diff computation, and edge cases like reverted or repeated overlapping edits.

nodes.name: hook_adapter.rs
nodes.summary: Normalizes agent hook payloads from multiple IDE/CLI sources (Windsurf, Cursor, Codex, etc.) into a canonical session/lifecycle event shape, deriving canonical session IDs and resource actions from tool calls.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for orgtrack-core that declares and re-exports all public modules (canonical types, adapters, projectors, sources, sync) forming the crate's public API surface.

nodes.name: policy.rs
nodes.summary: Defines per-source tier capture policy (which sources orgii owns vs. treats as external, and their default capture tiers) used to gate how much detail is recorded per data source.

nodes.name: pricing.rs
nodes.summary: Loads a model pricing catalog and resolves per-model token rates, normalizing provider-specific model IDs to canonical pricing keys for cost calculation.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the orgtrack privacy tier model (none/metadata/details/trajectory) and redaction policy config controlling how much session content is captured or stored.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the projector submodules (replay, session_blame, stats, turn_metadata) that derive read-model views from canonical records.

nodes.name: replay.rs
nodes.summary: Projects a session's file-change records into a replay view for reconstructing the sequence of edits made during a session.

nodes.name: session_blame.rs
nodes.summary: Builds a repo-level commit/session blame index from file-change records, tracking committed-vs-uncommitted rates and per-file/session summaries for repo_sync export.

nodes.name: stats.rs
nodes.summary: Projects raw file-change records into per-session summary statistics (files touched, line counts) used for dashboard/reporting views.

nodes.name: turn_metadata.rs
nodes.summary: Accumulates per-turn resource interactions, modified files, and git artifacts from provider-neutral tool events into a projected turn metadata record used by review UI and activity chunk rendering.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel/orchestration module that syncs the repo-shareable `.orgtrack` index by pulling file-change records from the store and delegating to the session_blame projector.

nodes.name: SessionRecord
nodes.summary: Canonical record describing a single coding-agent session (id, source, timestamps, repo context, status) that anchors all other per-session records.

nodes.name: ActivityRecord
nodes.summary: Canonical record for a single activity chunk (user message, assistant message, tool call) emitted during a session, used to build the activity timeline.

nodes.name: FileChangeRecord
nodes.summary: Canonical record capturing a single file modification within a session, including path, action, and line-count deltas.

nodes.name: SessionEditArtifactRecord
nodes.summary: Canonical record describing a normalized edit artifact (a file edit's diff/quality/kind) extracted from a session's tool events.

nodes.name: SessionDiffChunkRecord
nodes.summary: Canonical record for an individual diff hunk/chunk contributing to a session's edit history for a file.

nodes.name: SessionFinalDiffRecord
nodes.summary: Canonical record holding the final merged net diff for a file across an entire session, after reconciling overlapping edits.

nodes.name: SessionCheckpointRecord
nodes.summary: Canonical record for a session checkpoint snapshot, used to reconstruct file state at a point in time during replay.

nodes.name: parse_git_artifacts
nodes.summary: Parses commit and PR URL artifacts out of raw git command output collected during a session.

nodes.name: parse_git_artifacts_from_tool_payload
nodes.summary: Extracts git development artifacts (commits, pushes, PR links) from a tool call's JSON arguments and result payload.

nodes.name: artifacts_from_extracted_edit
nodes.summary: Builds normalized edit artifacts (quality, kind, diff chunks) from a raw extracted-edit event and its accumulated diff context.

nodes.name: final_diff_from_chunks
nodes.summary: Merges a sequence of per-edit diff chunks for a file into a single net final diff, reconciling overlapping and reverted changes.

nodes.name: merge_unified_diff_hunks
nodes.summary: Merges overlapping unified-diff hunks into a minimal consolidated hunk set for final diff computation.

nodes.name: final_diff_sums_disjoint_fragment_edits_instead_of_stitching
nodes.summary: Regression test verifying that disjoint fragment edits within a file are summed independently rather than incorrectly stitched into one hunk.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses a raw hook-source string identifier into the strongly-typed HookSource enum variant.

nodes.name: as_source_str
nodes.summary: Converts a HookSource enum variant back into its canonical source string identifier.

nodes.name: canonical_session_id
nodes.summary: Derives the canonical, source-prefixed session ID for a hook-originated session based on its HookSource.

nodes.name: canonical_lifecycle_session_id
nodes.summary: Derives the canonical session ID for a hook lifecycle event (start/end signal), mirroring canonical_session_id for lifecycle payloads.

nodes.name: normalize_hook_payload
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw agent hook payload (varying shapes per IDE/CLI source) into the canonical hook event structure consumed downstream.

nodes.name: normalize_windsurf_payload
nodes.summary: Normalizes Windsurf-specific hook payload fields into the canonical hook event shape.

nodes.name: normalize_actor_lifecycle_payload
nodes.summary: Normalizes an actor lifecycle (session start/end) hook payload into the canonical lifecycle event shape.

nodes.name: source_session_id
nodes.summary: Extracts the source-specific raw session ID field from a hook payload prior to canonicalization.

nodes.name: string_field
nodes.summary: Utility that extracts a named string field from a JSON payload value, returning None when absent or non-string.

nodes.name: HookSource
nodes.summary: Enum of supported agent hook sources (Windsurf, Cursor, Codex, etc.) with parsing and canonical session-ID derivation methods.

nodes.name: source_tier_policy
nodes.summary: Looks up the default capture-tier policy (owned vs. external, tier support) for a given source identifier.

nodes.name: SourceTierPolicy
nodes.summary: Struct describing a data source's tier capture policy, with constructors for orgii-owned and external-default sources.

nodes.name: resolve_pricing
nodes.summary: Resolves a model ID to its ModelPricing rates by looking up the normalized model ID in the loaded pricing catalog.

nodes.name: normalize_model_id
nodes.summary: Normalizes provider-specific model ID strings (stripping date suffixes and provider prefixes) into canonical pricing catalog keys.

nodes.name: ModelPricing
nodes.summary: Struct holding per-token input/output/cache pricing rates for a model, with default and catalog-entry conversion constructors.

nodes.name: OrgtrackTier
nodes.summary: Enum of orgtrack privacy tiers (none/metadata/details/trajectory) with helpers to parse from config strings and check what level of detail each tier includes.

nodes.name: project_replay
nodes.summary: Projects a session's ordered file-change records into a ReplayProjection used to reconstruct the session's edit sequence.

nodes.name: build_orgtrack_index_from_file_changes
nodes.summary: Aggregates a repo's file-change records into per-session and per-file accumulators, producing the OrgtrackIndex used for repo-level blame/commit-rate reporting.

nodes.name: session_summaries
nodes.summary: Projects file-change records grouped by session into CoreSessionSummary rows summarizing files touched and lines changed per session.

nodes.name: add_event_at
nodes.summary: Feeds a single tool event (with explicit timestamp) into the turn accumulator, merging derived file interactions and git artifacts from the event's tool call.

nodes.name: project_activity_chunks
nodes.summary: Projects a turn's accumulated events into a list of rendered activity chunk texts for display in the review UI.

nodes.name: extract_patch_files
nodes.summary: Extracts the set of files touched by a unified-diff patch tool event, used to populate turn-level modified-file metadata.

nodes.name: extract_files_from_patch_text
nodes.summary: Parses raw unified-diff patch text to enumerate the file paths it modifies.

nodes.name: TurnMetadataAccumulator
nodes.summary: Stateful accumulator that collects modified files, resource interactions, and git artifacts across a turn's events, exposing accessors for the projected results.

nodes.name: sync_repo_from_store
nodes.summary: Orchestrates repo-shareable `.orgtrack` sync by pulling file-change records from the RecordStore and building the repo index via the session_blame projector.
